'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Jake Pietruszewski DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jake Pietruszewski]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif}}
* '''Username:''' jake.irish
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
